# `Q-3-12` — Unresolved Note Reference

> A note reference was not converted to a Span during
> postprocessing. This is a bug in the postprocessor.

## What this means

Quarto's render pipeline runs a postprocessing pass before the
writer that, among other things, resolves footnote references to
their final form. If the writer encounters a raw note-reference
node, the postprocessor missed it — the reference reached the
writer in a shape the writer is not prepared to handle.

This is an internal-consistency error, not something the document
author wrote incorrectly. The page exists so the catalog stays
self-contained, but a user reading this is almost certainly
looking at a bug, not at a fixable document mistake.

## Why this happens

Two known triggers:

- **A bug in the postprocessing pass** that misses a particular
  shape of note reference.
- **A Lua filter that bypassed postprocessing**, or that
  re-introduced a `NoteReference` node after postprocessing ran.

## How to fix

Report the document and the exact command that triggered the
error at the Quarto issue tracker. If a Lua filter is involved,
verify it does not produce `NoteReference` AST nodes after
postprocessing.
